add.doc: Create a new contact tag. Adds a named tag to the user's hub for categorising contacts. The tag is created with an empty description by default. Returns the newly created tag record.

name.description: Display name for the new tag

tag_id.description: Unique identifier for the created tag

description.description: Tag description, empty string by default

entity_assign.doc: Assign one or more tags to a contact entity or shared hub. Replaces all existing tag assignments for the entity with the supplied list. Validates every tag_id before applying and verifies the entity is a known contact or a hub-type shared room. Sends a WebSocket notification to the owner's sockets when the entity is a shared hub rather than a direct contact.

entity_id.description: ID of the contact entity or shared hub node to tag

tag.description: Tag ID or array of tag IDs to assign. Accepts a single tag_id string or an array. Falls back to the list parameter if omitted. Defaults to empty array.

list.description: Alternative parameter for tag IDs array when tag parameter is not provided

returns.description: Updated list of tag assignments for the entity

entity_id.description: Entity ID this tag is assigned to

errors.message: One or more of the supplied tag IDs do not exist in the hub
entity_id does not correspond to a known contact or a hub-type shared room

entity_assign_get.doc: Get all tags currently assigned to a contact entity. Queries the calling user's personal database via forward_proc to retrieve tag assignments for the given entity. Returns an empty list when no tags are assigned.

entity_id.description: ID of the contact entity whose tag assignments are to be retrieved

returns.description: List of tag records assigned to the entity

entity_id.description: Entity ID this tag is assigned to

tag_assign.doc: Set a parent-child relationship between two tags. Validates that both tag and parent tag exist, then checks that assigning the parent would not create a circular hierarchy. Raises CANT_ASSIGN when the target tag is already an ancestor of the proposed parent.

tag_id.description: ID of the child tag to be assigned under a parent

returns.description: Updated tag relationship record from the tag_assign stored procedure

errors.message: The child tag identified by tag_id does not exist
The parent tag identified by parent_id does not exist
Assigning this parent would create a circular tag hierarchy

reposition.doc: Reorder the display position of tags. Accepts an ordered list of tag position entries and persists the new order via the tag_reposition stored procedure. Returns the updated ordered tag list.

content.description: Ordered array of tag position objects defining the new sort order. Passed as JSON string to the tag_reposition stored procedure.

position.description: New position index for the tag

returns.description: Updated tag list reflecting the new positions

remove.doc: Delete a contact tag by ID. Removes the tag record via the tag_remove stored procedure. All entity assignments referencing this tag are also removed by the stored procedure via cascade.

tag_id.description: ID of the tag to delete

returns.description: Result from the tag_remove stored procedure

rename.doc: Rename an existing contact tag. Verifies the tag exists before applying the new name. Returns the updated tag record after renaming.

tag_id.description: ID of the tag to rename

name.description: New display name for the tag

errors.message: No tag found for the given tag_id

show_tag_by.doc: List tags with optional filtering and pagination. Wraps the tag_get_next stored procedure. Can filter by a parent tag_id, search by keyword, control sort order, and paginate results. When tag_id is empty all top-level tags are returned.

tag_id.description: Parent tag ID to filter by. Empty string returns all top-level tags.

search.description: Keyword to filter tags by name

order.description: Sort order for results. Accepted values: asc, desc.

returns.description: Paginated list of tag records matching the filter criteria

parent_id.description: Parent tag ID if this tag is nested
